sonnet.problem: The card says Moses "calls together" the heads of the tribes "because he has a command to pass on." Numbers 30:1 only says Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes. It gives no gathering and no reason for speaking, so the card adds a setting and a motive.
sonnet.rule: No added settings. No setting the text doesn't give. / Reasons. He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.
